trees.name: Kuru Dynasty
trees.description: The royal lineage of Hastinapura — Mahabharata

trees.name: Raghu / Ikshvaku Dynasty
trees.description: Solar dynasty of Ayodhya — Ramayana lineage

persons.name: Shantanu
persons.notes: King of Hastinapura. Married Ganga and later Satyavati.

persons.name: Ganga
persons.notes: Divine river goddess. First wife of Shantanu. Mother of Bhishma.

persons.name: Satyavati
persons.notes: Second wife of Shantanu. Previously had Vyasa with Parashara.

persons.name: Parashara
persons.notes: Sage. Father of Vyasa with Satyavati before her marriage.

persons.name: Bhishma
persons.notes: Born Devavrata. Son of Shantanu and Ganga. Took the terrible oath of celibacy.

persons.name: Vyasa
persons.notes: Also called Krishna Dvaipayana. Son of Parashara and Satyavati. Author of Mahabharata. Fathered Pandu, Dhritarashtra, and Vidura by niyoga.

persons.name: Chitrangada
persons.notes: Son of Shantanu and Satyavati. Died young in battle.

persons.name: Vichitravirya
persons.notes: Son of Shantanu and Satyavati. Married Ambika and Ambalika. Died childless.

persons.name: Ambika
persons.notes: Wife of Vichitravirya. Mother of Dhritarashtra (by Vyasa, niyoga).

persons.name: Ambalika
persons.notes: Wife of Vichitravirya. Mother of Pandu (by Vyasa, niyoga).

persons.name: Parishrami
persons.notes: Maid of Ambika. Mother of Vidura (by Vyasa, niyoga). Vidura hence born wise and just.

persons.name: Dhritarashtra
persons.notes: Blind king of Hastinapura. Son of Vyasa and Ambika. Father of 100 Kauravas.

persons.name: Gandhari
persons.notes: Princess of Gandhara. Wife of Dhritarashtra. Blindfolded herself out of loyalty. Mother of Kauravas.

persons.name: Pandu
persons.notes: King of Hastinapura. Son of Vyasa and Ambalika. Cursed — could not father children directly.

persons.name: Kunti
persons.notes: First wife of Pandu. Could invoke gods to bear children. Mother of Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna.

persons.name: Madri
persons.notes: Second wife of Pandu. Mother of Nakula and Sahadeva by the Ashwini twins.

persons.name: Vidura
persons.notes: Son of Vyasa and Parishrami. Known for his wisdom and dharma. Half-brother to Pandu and Dhritarashtra.

persons.name: Duryodhana
persons.notes: Eldest of the 100 Kauravas. Son of Dhritarashtra and Gandhari. Primary antagonist of Mahabharata.

persons.name: Dushasana
persons.notes: Second Kaurava. Notorious for the disrobing of Draupadi.

persons.name: Yudhishthira
persons.notes: Eldest Pandava. Son of Dharma (Yama) and Kunti. Renowned for truth and righteousness.

persons.name: Bhima
persons.notes: Second Pandava. Son of Vayu and Kunti. Immense strength. Killed all 100 Kauravas.

persons.name: Arjuna
persons.notes: Third Pandava. Son of Indra and Kunti. Greatest archer. Received Bhagavad Gita from Krishna.

persons.name: Nakula
persons.notes: Fourth Pandava. Son of Ashwini twins and Madri. Known for beauty and skill with horses.

persons.name: Sahadeva
persons.notes: Fifth Pandava. Son of Ashwini twins and Madri. Scholar and astrologer.

persons.name: Draupadi
persons.notes: Daughter of Drupada. Common wife of all five Pandavas. Born from fire.

persons.name: Drupada
persons.notes: King of Panchala. Father of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna.

persons.name: Subhadra
persons.notes: Sister of Krishna and Balarama. Second wife of Arjuna. Mother of Abhimanyu.

persons.name: Krishna
persons.notes: Avatar of Vishnu. Prince of Dwarka. Cousin of Pandavas. Arjuna's charioteer and guide.

persons.name: Abhimanyu
persons.notes: Son of Arjuna and Subhadra. Heroic warrior. Killed in the Chakravyuha formation.

persons.name: Uttara
persons.notes: Princess of Virata. Married Abhimanyu. Mother of Parikshit.

persons.name: Parikshit
persons.notes: Son of Abhimanyu and Uttara. Survived Ashwatthama's brahmastra in womb. Succeeded Pandavas as king.

persons.name: Karna
persons.notes: Son of Surya and Kunti (before her marriage). Raised by charioteer Adhiratha. Tragic hero.

persons.name: Hidimbi
persons.notes: Rakshasi who married Bhima. Mother of Ghatotkacha.

persons.name: Ghatotkacha
persons.notes: Son of Bhima and Hidimbi. Half-human, half-rakshasa. Killed by Karna's Vasavi Shakti.

persons.name: Dhrishtadyumna
persons.notes: Son of Drupada. Brother of Draupadi. Commander of Pandava army. Killed Drona.
